summary.en: Precedence groups operators of different levels.
summary.bn: precedence দিয়ে grouping আর associativity দিয়ে একই স্তরের grouping বোঝো; execution order আলাদা রাখো।

notes: The reference table describes C17. Compound literals were added in C99 and _Alignof in C11. The basic arithmetic precedence levels are older. Newer keyword spellings do not make grouping and execution order the same concept.

examples.title: Compare two groupings
examples.explanationHtml: The unparenthesized product binds first and gives fourteen overall. The parenthesized sum gives five before multiplication, making twenty. The example demonstrates grouping without depending on side effects or unspecified operand evaluation order.

examples.title: Subtraction associates left
examples.explanationHtml: The first expression groups the two left operands, giving fourteen and then eleven. The second subtracts the parenthesized three from twenty, giving seventeen. The changed parentheses alter the mathematical expression itself.

examples.title: Make bit and logical grouping explicit
examples.explanationHtml: The mask intersection is performed before comparing with zero. The parenthesized OR group is true because two is less than three. AND combines that truth with ready. The displayed pair is one and one.

practice.title: A grouped sum product
practice.statementHtml: Read a, b and c from 0 to 20. After the prompt Input: , print (a + b) * c and newline.

practice.title: Two subtraction trees
practice.statementHtml: Read a, b and c from 0 to 20. After the prompt Input: , print a - b - c and a - (b - c), separated by a space and newline.

practice.title: Mean of three marks
practice.statementHtml: Read a, b and c from 0 to 100. After the prompt Input: , print their floating mean to two decimals and newline.
hints: The entire sum must be the numerator.

practice.title: A parenthesized eligibility rule
practice.statementHtml: Read attendance, mark and special, where the first two are 0 to 100 and special is 0 or 1. After the prompt Input: , print 1 when attendance is at least 75 and either mark is at least 40 or special is true; otherwise print 0, then newline.
hints: Show the alternative mark rule as one parenthesized operand.

quiz.prompt: What does left associativity make a - b - c mean?
Which level binds more tightly: multiplication or addition?
quiz.explanation: The product forms a subexpression before addition.
Chains group around the right assignment.

quiz.prompt: Which has lower precedence: bitwise AND or equality?
quiz.explanation: A bit test therefore needs explicit grouping before comparing.

quiz.prompt: Do parentheses fix i = i++ in C17?
Why use parentheses in a mixed logical eligibility rule?
options: To force every operand to run
To change integers into bool objects
quiz.explanation: They make the rule easier to verify against the requirement.

quiz.prompt: Multiplication binds inside the sum. What is the result?
quiz.explanation: The product ten is added to six.

quiz.prompt: Left-associated division loses fractions at each step. What appears?
quiz.explanation: Twenty divided by three gives six, then division by two gives three.

quiz.prompt: The sum is explicitly grouped before multiplication. Which value prints?

keyPoints.en: Precedence groups operators of different levels.
keyPoints.bn: ভিন্ন স্তরের operator কীভাবে group হবে তা precedence বলে।

keyPoints.en: Associativity groups operators on one level.
keyPoints.bn: একই স্তরের operator-এর grouping associativity বলে।

keyPoints.en: Grouping is different from evaluation order.
keyPoints.bn: grouping আর কোন কাজ আগে চলবে, দুটো আলাদা বিষয়।

keyPoints.en: Parentheses make the intended formula visible.
keyPoints.bn: parentheses দিলে সূত্রের উদ্দেশ্য পরিষ্কার হয়।

keyPoints.en: Unsequenced updates have no portable numeric answer.
keyPoints.bn: unsequenced update-এর নির্দিষ্ট output ধরে নেওয়া যায় না।

examQuestions.question: What does precedence determine?
examQuestions.answerHtml: How operands group. It describes the expression grammar.

examQuestions.question: What does left associativity make a - b - c mean?
examQuestions.answerHtml: (a - b) - c. Same-level subtraction groups left.

examQuestions.question: Read attendance, mark and special, where the first two are 0 to 100 and special is 0 or 1. After Input: print 1 when attendance is at least 75 and either mark is at least 40 or special is true; otherwise print 0, then newline.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>

int main(void)
{
    int attendance, mark, special;
    printf("Input: ");
    if (scanf("%d %d %d", &attendance, &mark, &special) != 3 || attendance < 0 || attendance > 100 || mark < 0 || mark > 100
        || special < 0 || special > 1) {
        return 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", attendance >= 75 && (mark >= 40 || special));
    return 0;
}
